lyrics:
[Intro: warm analog synth chords, soft drum machine]

[Verse 1: gentle, low, reflective]
Just one more look before I merge
The water tower, the college church
I knew a kid who lived round here
He had my face and half my fear

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters, drums build]
He's on the corner in a coat too thin
I slow the car to let him in

[Chorus: full band, one long soaring line]
And when I'm back in that zip code, I see him
Another one of me, still dreaming
He's twenty-four and he's got no idea
I honk the horn and I wave
And I leave him here

[Verse 2: gentle, a little warmer]
The bar's a bank, the bank's a gym
The song they played still sounds like him
I could tell him how it all turns out
He wouldn't listen, he'd find out

[Pre-Chorus: bass and drums build]
He's on the corner looking at the sky
I think he saw me driving by

[Chorus: full band, one long soaring line]
And when I'm back in that zip code, I see him
Another one of me, still dreaming
He's twenty-four and he's got no idea
I honk the horn and I wave
And I leave him here

[Bridge: synths swell, guitar feedback, voice rising]
You take the man out of the town
You take the town out of the man
You can't, you can't

[Final Chorus: biggest, guitars, held last note]
And when I'm back in that zip code, I see him
Another one of me, still dreaming
He's twenty-four and he's got no idea
I honk the horn and I wave
And I leave him here

[Outro: synth chords, a car indicator ticking, fade]
